# foundry_deployments (Data Source)

Lists the model deployments available to the configured Foundry project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "foundry_deployments" "available" {}

# Use a deployment name to back an agent.
output "chat_deployments" {
  value = [
    for deployment in data.foundry_deployments.available.deployments :
    deployment.name if deployment.model_publisher == "OpenAI"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `deployments` (Attributes List) Model deployments available to the project. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deployments))

<a id="nestedatt--deployments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `deployments`

Read-Only:

- `model_name` (String) Deployed model name.
- `model_publisher` (String) Publisher of the deployed model.
- `model_version` (String) Deployed model version.
- `name` (String) Deployment name, used as the `model` value on an agent.
- `sku_capacity` (Number) Provisioned SKU capacity.
- `sku_name` (String) SKU name of the deployment.
- `type` (String) Deployment type.
